title: Kitchen Concierge Cart
description: The cart the skill builds in the browser, written to ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/pending-cart.json and read by scripts/verify_cart.mjs. Line items carry BOTH what was requested and what was actually matched in the store — the allergen check needs the matched product title, because a retailer's 'Almond Meal 500g' is what reaches the table, not the requested 'flour'.

name.description: What was requested, in plain language (e.g. 'tomatoes').

matched_product.description: The product title as shown by the retailer. REQUIRED for allergen checking once the item is in the trolley — verify_cart.mjs matches restrictions against this, not against `name`.

unit_price_aud.description: Price the retailer showed. Compared against max_price_aud.

max_price_aud.description: Per-item ceiling. Exceeding it triggers exit 30 and question R3.

substituted.description: True when the retailer supplied something other than the exact match. Any true value is rejected outright when the household carries a life_threatening or medical_avoid restriction.

substitution_note.description: What was swapped in. Scanned for allergens alongside matched_product — substitutions are where allergens sneak in.

substitution.description: Per-item policy. `deny` plus `substituted: true` is exit 50.

recipe_source.description: Recipe this ingredient came from. Log only.
